# Azbaan global

> Professional attestation, apostille, MOFA, embassy, and consulate legalization services in the UAE, India, and 40+ countries.

Azbaan global (also known as Azbaan) helps individuals and businesses authenticate personal, educational, and commercial documents for international use. Offices in Dubai, Delhi, and Kochi support certificate attestation workflows for UAE MOFA, Indian HRD/MEA, and destination-country embassy requirements.

## Primary pages

- Home: https://azbaanglobal.com/
- Attestation services Delhi: https://azbaanglobal.com/attestation-services-delhi
- Attestation services Dubai: https://azbaanglobal.com/attestation-services-dubai
- Attestation services Kochi: https://azbaanglobal.com/attestation-services-kochi
- Sitemap: https://azbaanglobal.com/sitemap.xml

## Core services

- Personal certificate attestation (birth, marriage, and civil documents)
- Educational certificate attestation (school, diploma, degree, and university records)
- Commercial document attestation and company paperwork legalization
- MOFA attestation and UAE ministry coordination
- Embassy and consulate attestation
- Apostille services for Hague Convention destinations
- Indian attestation services (Delhi, Kochi, Kozhikode, Mumbai)
